The calm, uncluttered layout feels right, and newest-first is a sensible default.

The saved item itself isn’t quite what I want yet. A title guessed from the address may be hard to recognise; I’d expect the app to collect the page’s real title, a short description, and its small site icon automatically. I’d like to be able to correct the title or description before saving and edit them later. The site-name chip is useful context, but it shouldn’t look like one of my own tags.

One other important part of saving: if I paste a link I’ve already saved, I don’t want a duplicate. Please take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it instead.
